rationale1: First, we need to find the proportion of Americans who have extended - family. Since the proportion of those who don't have extended family is 1%, the proportion of those who have extended family is 100% - 1% = 99%. The proportion of those with all or most, some, and only a few of their extended - family members living within an hour's drive are 28%, 27%, and 24% respectively. The sum of these three proportions is 28%+27%+24% = 79%. So the proportion of Americans who have extended - family members and at least some of them live within an hour's drive is 79% out of the 99% who have extended family. We can calculate this proportion by dividing 79 by 99 and multiplying by 100. But we can also calculate the result in another way.
